Interpretation: PEM includes all documented crash dates; crash is a subset, not a separate additive count. Sparse weeks are omitted, not plotted as zero. Watch metrics are measurements, not diagnoses. Months before diary coverage have no bowel or rating estimates.

Display: Charts use separate scales and one shared calendar. Watch sleep stages are shown as stacked columns; numbers above measurements summarize each period. Clinical milestones are event markers, not measurements.
